answer: Quartz toll: each identity mints a quartz token for a harbor berth. The mint charges per anchor: token one costs 30, token two 60, token three 90, so fake k costs 30k and k fakes pay 15k(k+1): 10 fakes pay 1,650, 100 fakes pay 151,500. Each dawn the harbor calls the roll; a token not presented forfeits its berth, so a sybil must wake every fake at dawn or lose the outlay.
